leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Promise.all function that accepts an array of promises
Initialize a results array to store resolved values in order
Implement promise resolution tracking using a counter
Integrate error handling to reject immediately when any promise fails
Manipulate the results array to maintain input order of resolved values
Control the flow of asynchronous operations to wait for all promises
Apply the custom Promise.all to handle multiple asynchronous tasks
